assets.title: Father, forgive them (close)

assets.doctrine: the red-letter prayer 'Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do'

assets.title: The cross over us

assets.subject: A shadowed crowd mocking — shaking heads, shot-out lips — the scorn a curse was expected to answer.
